title: Admissibility, recoverability and persistence are three separate tests

statements.text: Above the conserved root, admissibility decides which continuations are lawful, recoverability decides whether a later state identifies its antecedent, and persistence decides which identities endure. Conservation of one quantity can coexist with complete loss of state information.

sources.quote: conservation of one quantity may coexist with complete loss of state information. Persistence is therefore neither conservation nor recoverability

Admissibility determines which continuations are lawful; Recoverability determines which structures survive their evolution; Persistence determines which recoverable structures endure sufficiently to constitute physical order.
